metadata.source: MTA OD estimates 2021–2025; all 60 validated monthly partitions.

network.transfer_cost: max(1 m, endpoint distance, GTFS minimum transfer time × 8 m/s), by direction
network.meaning: Static GTFS parent-stop graph with directed declared transfers and multi-source/multi-target OD complex access.

metadata.method: Calendar-weighted annual OD. Static GTFS minimum modeled cost, combining rail distance and declared transfer cost.
metadata.sparse_assumption: An absent OD cell inside a complete published month contributes zero. Missing months are rejected.

raeb.dtype: little-endian Float32, dense origin-major square matrix; includes self OD without a rendered route
